text: 30省份亮出财政半年报：收入好于预期，西藏新疆增速高 上半年地方财政收支整体呈现收入好于预期、支出有待进一步发力的特征。
text_en: 30 provinces release fiscal semi-annual reports: revenue better than expected, Tibet and Xinjiang see high growth; first-half local fiscal revenue and expenditure overall show revenue better than expected, with expenditure awaiting further boost
